{{Top}}
[[File:Medals.png|thumb|right|250px|The Heroes of Yavin]]
{{Quote|It should come as no surprise that the so-called 'Heroes of Yavin' were once again at the hub of activity.|Voren Na'al, to the Alliance of Free Planets Provisional Council, regarding the Bakura Incident|<ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The '''Heroes of Yavin''' was a collective term used by historians such as [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] and [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] to refer to the small cadre of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] responsible for the defeat of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]&mdash;namely, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. They were also known as the '''Star Warriors'''. Later, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] came to be associated with this group, even though he did not participate in the attack on the first Death Star. Though named for their [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|victory at Yavin 4]], they were instrumental to the success of the Rebellion, the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] in countless ways.

For the most part, the group did not compose a formal unit. For some time after the Battle of Yavin, Skywalker was not even given a formal rank.<ref name="Splinter">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name=Companion>''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Heroes of Yavin were organized into the [[Rapid Response Team (SPIN)|Rapid Response Team]], a special-operations unit within the [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]].<ref name="Glove">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref> This team was short-lived, however.<ref name="SPINblog">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref> Not long after the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance's historian corps assigned Voren Na'al to document the lives and actions of the Heroes,<ref name="GG1">[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope'' (Second Edition)]]</ref> a task that he carried out with enthusiasm through the Battles of [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Bakura Incident|Bakura]], and beyond.<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'' (Second Edition)]]</ref><ref name="GG5">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'' (Second Edition)]]</ref><ref name="The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'']] series often referred to this group of characters as the "[[Star Warriors (term)|Star Warriors]]."
